[p0001] CHAPTER 1 THE SIGNAL
[p0002] Lieutenant Ilse Varga kept watch from the tower at Greyford.
[p0003] Every night the smuggler called the Grey Fox slipped boats past her tower.
[p0004] Ilse and the Grey Fox were sworn enemies.
[p0005] Her brother Tomas trimmed the signal lamp beside her.
[p0006] No one in Greyford knew the Grey Fox’s real name.
[p0007] The ferryman Petr Lask rowed the night crossing alone, humming an old song.
[p0008] Ilse served in the Harbor Watch, which guarded the river mouth.
[p0009] The Harbor Watch had sworn to hunt down the Grey Fox.
